judgment.rationale: The issue says 'none of the hot keys work,' but the reviewed public bug-report evidence does not show a simple full-runner failure and points instead to a narrower shortcut or input-stack conflict.
evidence: The reporter changed to HP keyboard/mouse hardware with its own settings software shortly before the problem started.
The reviewed runner log shows PowerToys starting normally and registering many hotkey actions, including Always On Top, Text Extractor, Crop and Lock, and others.
That same settings snapshot shows Keyboard Manager disabled, which already narrows some of the user's 'none of them' description.
The current public evidence does not identify which specific shortcuts/modules failed or whether HP input software is intercepting them.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact failing shortcuts/modules, the HP software/driver context, and a fresh post-failure bug report instead of assuming a universal PowerToys outage.

fix_assessment.rationale: A code fix would be speculative until the failing shortcuts and the role of the new HP input stack are identified.

issue_context.summary: After switching to HP keyboard and mouse hardware, the reporter says PowerToys hotkeys no longer work. The reviewed bug-report logs show PowerToys starting and registering multiple hotkeys, so the remaining gap is which shortcuts actually fail and whether HP software is intercepting them.
known_information: The issue targets PowerToys 0.100.2 and says reinstalling PowerToys and rebooting did not help.
The reporter specifically mentions a new HP 725 Capacitor Wireless Keyboard and HP 720M mouse with their own settings.
A public PowerToysReport ZIP was attached and reviewed during triage.
The reviewed runner log shows many module hotkeys being registered successfully, while Keyboard Manager is disabled in the saved settings snapshot.
inferences: This does not currently look like a simple total failure to start PowerToys or register every hotkey.
A third-party input utility or device-mode behavior is a plausible contributor, but the live issue does not say which specific shortcuts stopped working.
issue_context.analysis: This should stay in needs-information. The reviewed bundle already adds some value—it prevents a generic 'send logs' response—but it still does not isolate the failing shortcuts or the role of the new HP input stack. A narrow request can do that without wasting time on speculative code investigation.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the live issue body and the attached public bug-report bundle.
Inspected the runner log from the failing timeframe and confirmed PowerToys registered multiple hotkey actions successfully.
Noted that Keyboard Manager was disabled in the captured settings snapshot, which means not every hotkey path the reporter may expect is even active.
Compared the issue description against the new HP peripheral/software context mentioned by the reporter.

information_gaps.information: The exact PowerToys shortcuts or modules that fail now, and whether any PowerToys shortcut still works.
information_gaps.why_needed: The reviewed logs show many registrations succeeded, so the remaining question is which concrete hotkey paths are broken.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please list 2-3 specific PowerToys shortcuts you tested (for example Always On Top, Text Extractor, Shortcut Guide), what each one should do, and what actually happened.

information_gaps.information: The HP keyboard/mouse software or driver package in use, and whether exiting or disabling it changes the behavior.
information_gaps.why_needed: The new peripheral software is the clearest issue-specific environmental change and may be intercepting shortcuts before PowerToys sees them.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please tell us which HP utility/driver package is installed for the new keyboard/mouse, and whether the problem changes if you fully exit that software or test with the previous keyboard/mouse.

information_gaps.information: A fresh diagnostic bundle from a session where the hotkeys are currently failing.
information_gaps.why_needed: The already reviewed bundle proved startup and registration activity, but a fresh capture tied to a concrete failing shortcut will be more actionable.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: After reproducing the failing shortcuts, please comment /bugreport on the issue and attach the generated ZIP.

actions.label: Identify failed hotkeys and HP software interaction
actions.note: Ask for issue-specific shortcut and peripheral-software evidence rather than a generic retry request.

confidence.rationale: The existing bundle proves PowerToys is doing some hotkey registration, but not which user-visible shortcuts still fail.
